# Importing the data
```{r}
st <- read.table( "s10_data_Dakota_matching.csv", header=TRUE, sep=",", fill = TRUE )
#st <- read.table( "pilotdata/example_data.csv", header=TRUE, sep=",", fill = TRUE )
#s1$subj= 1

st2 <- read.table( "s9_data_moin_matching.csv", header=TRUE, sep=",", fill = TRUE )
#st2 <- read.table( "pilotdata/example_data.csv", header=TRUE, sep=",", fill = TRUE )
#st2$Subject = 2

total_data = rbind(st, st2)
#total_data = rbind(st)
total_data
```

# Cleaning Likert Data
```{r}
tidy_likert <- total_data %>%
  filter(DataType == "likert") %>%
  select(-VirtualObjDepth)

tidy_likert
```

# Cleaning Matching Data
```{r}
tidy_matching <- total_data %>%
  filter(DataType == "matching") %>%
  select(-Question)

tidy_matching$absValue = abs(tidy_matching$Value)

tidy_matching
```


# Data Analysis Matching Abs
```{r}
D_Sub_Abs <- tidy_matching |> 
  group_by(Subject, ZoomType, ZoomLevel, VirtualObjDepth) |> 
  summarize(
    N = n(),
    M_Est = mean(absValue, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD_Est = sd(absValue, na.rm = TRUE),
    SE_Est = SD_Est / sqrt(N)
  ) |> 
  ungroup()

D_Sub_Abs$Subject = factor(D_Sub_Abs$Subject)
D_Sub_Abs$ZoomType = factor(D_Sub_Abs$ZoomType)
D_Sub_Abs$ZoomLevel = factor(D_Sub_Abs$ZoomLevel)

D_graph_abs <- tidy_matching |> 
  group_by(ZoomType, ZoomLevel) |> 
  summarize(
    N = n(),
    M_Est = mean(absValue, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD_Est = sd(absValue, na.rm = TRUE),
    SE_Est = SD_Est / sqrt(N)
  ) |> 
  ungroup()

D_graph_abs_dist <- tidy_matching |> 
  group_by(ZoomType, VirtualObjDepth) |> 
  summarize(
    N = n(),
    M_Est = mean(absValue, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD_Est = sd(absValue, na.rm = TRUE),
    SE_Est = SD_Est / sqrt(N)
  ) |> 
  ungroup()

D_graph_abs
```

# Matching Graph abs
```{r}
G1 <- D_graph_abs |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = ZoomLevel, y = M_Est))+
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymax = M_Est + SE_Est, ymin = M_Est - SE_Est, color = ZoomType), linewidth = 1, width = .2, alpha = .7) +
  geom_line(aes(group = ZoomType), linewidth = 1) +
  geom_line(aes(color = ZoomType), linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = ZoomType), size = 3, shape = 21)+
  scale_color_brewer(palette  = "Set2", guide = NULL) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette  = "Set2", name = "ZoomType:",
                       guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 21))) + 
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 4), name = "Zoom Level", breaks=c(0.00, 1.00, 2.00, 3.00, 4.00)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 0.025), name = "Error (Abs)")
G1
```

```{r}
G2 <- D_graph_abs_dist |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = VirtualObjDepth, y = M_Est))+
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymax = M_Est + SE_Est, ymin = M_Est - SE_Est, color = ZoomType), linewidth = 1, width = .01, alpha = .7) +
  geom_line(aes(group = ZoomType), linewidth = 1) +
  geom_line(aes(color = ZoomType), linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = ZoomType), size = 3, shape = 21)+
  scale_color_brewer(palette  = "Set2", guide = NULL) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette  = "Set2", name = "ZoomType:",
                       guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 21))) + 
  scale_x_continuous(name = "Egocentric Depth") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 0.025), name = "Error (Abs)")
G2
```


# Data Analysis Matching
```{r}
D_Sub <- tidy_matching |> 
  group_by(Subject, ZoomType, ZoomLevel, VirtualObjDepth) |> 
  summarize(
    N = n(),
    M_Est = mean(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD_Est = sd(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    SE_Est = SD_Est / sqrt(N)
  ) |> 
  ungroup()

D_Sub$Subject = factor(D_Sub$Subject)
D_Sub$ZoomType = factor(D_Sub$ZoomType)
D_Sub$ZoomLevel = factor(D_Sub$ZoomLevel)

D_graph <- tidy_matching |> 
  group_by(ZoomType, ZoomLevel) |> 
  summarize(
    N = n(),
    M_Est = mean(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD_Est = sd(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    SE_Est = SD_Est / sqrt(N)
  ) |> 
  ungroup()

D_graph_dist <- tidy_matching |> 
  group_by(ZoomType, VirtualObjDepth) |> 
  summarize(
    N = n(),
    M_Est = mean(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD_Est = sd(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    SE_Est = SD_Est / sqrt(N)
  ) |> 
  ungroup()

D_graph
```

# Matching Graph
```{r}
G3 <- D_graph |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = ZoomLevel, y = M_Est))+
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymax = M_Est + SE_Est, ymin = M_Est - SE_Est, color = ZoomType), linewidth = 1, width = .2, alpha = .7) +
  geom_ref_line(h = 0, size = 1, colour = "black") +
  geom_line(aes(group = ZoomType), linewidth = 1) +
  geom_line(aes(color = ZoomType), linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = ZoomType), size = 3, shape = 21)+
  scale_color_brewer(palette  = "Set2", guide = NULL) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette  = "Set2", name = "ZoomType:",
                       guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 21))) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 4), name = "Zoom Level", breaks=c(0.00, 1.00, 2.00, 3.00, 4.00)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-0.015, 0.015), name = "Error")
G3
```
